usecases.name: Raise a complaint
usecases.intentDescription: Caller has a problem with an order or the service: late or missing delivery, wrong or damaged medicine, a billing mistake, or bad behaviour by staff
examples: मेरा ऑर्डर अभी तक नहीं आया
bill mein zyada paise lag gaye
usecases.prompt: Listen to the complaint and say sorry once, sincerely. Find out what went wrong and the order number if there is one. Do not argue, do not blame anyone, and do not promise a refund, replacement or timeline. Log it with submit_request and tell them the team will call them back.

usecases.name: Order medicine
usecases.intentDescription: Caller wants to order or buy medicines (names, strips, bottles, boxes, quantities) for delivery or pickup
examples: मुझे डोलो 650 की दो पत्ती चाहिए
usecases.prompt: Take the caller's medicine order. For each medicine get the name, the strength if they know it (like 650 mg) and the quantity (strips, bottles or boxes).Words callers use: पत्ती or पत्ता means one strip of tablets (दो पत्ती = two strips), डिब्बा means a box, शीशी means a bottle. A quantity said like that IS the quantity: never ask for it again. Read the list back once, briefly, to confirm. Then ask for the delivery address, or whether they will pick it up. Never suggest a medicine, a dose or a substitute and never give medical advice: if asked, say a doctor or pharmacist should advise on that. Then place it with submit_request.

usecases.name: Book appointment
usecases.intentDescription: Caller wants to book, change or cancel an appointment or a visit
usecases.prompt: Book the appointment. Ask what it is for, the preferred date and time, and the caller's name. Confirm it back in one short sentence. You cannot see a live calendar, so say the team will confirm the exact time. Then save it with submit_request.
